title: Venezuelan Vermicelli Salad
description: A citrusy and refreshing salad inspired by Venezuelan cuisine, made with vermicelli noodles and featuring a zesty twist.
instructions: Cook the vermicelli noodles according to package instructions.
In a large bowl, whisk together the citrusy and Venezuelan ingredients.
Add the sliced xanthous to the bowl and toss to combine.
In a separate pan, sauté the sliced xanthous until softened.
Add the cooked noodles to the bowl and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Garnish with chopped xanthous before serving.
